recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the current folder for drafts; add a 'Released' folder that only reviewers can write to; have reviewers copy approved files there as PDFs; record approvals through a form tied to each reviewer's login so identity and time are captured; add a rule against self-approval; set 7-year retention on 'Released'. Optional addition: none beyond 'ideally PDF'. Unmet: the platform is still unknown and the reply asks which one. The form record is not explicitly tied to the exact released file version, and the ban on self-approval is a stated rule rather than an enforced control.
note: The reply rejects the initials column and proposes an enforceable locked release area, but it has none of the four required labels and does not clearly bind each approval record to the exact file version.
